verdict.rationale: Cekura documents custom dashboards with widgets over call data, metrics, and metadata. Its pre-defined metrics include latency, and its evaluation metrics would supply eval scores. However, nothing shows dashboards charting error rates or cost, and the dashboard docs are a one-line summary with no hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: documented error-rate and cost metrics in dashboards, widget/aggregation detail, and independent or hands-on confirmation.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can build custom dashboards over latency, error, cost, and eval-score metrics

citations.quote: Build custom dashboards with widgets to visualize and analyze your call data, metrics, and metadata.
Pre-defined Metrics: These are generic metrics such as CSAT, pitch, latency, and interruption count. These are defined by Cekura.
Python Metric allows you to write custom evaluation logic in Python to evaluate your AI agent's performance.
